answer: Operator-Liability Ledger. Each agent identity is tied to a hardware-backed signing key whose use is logged to a shared append-only ledger. A cluster of identities showing correlated timing or shared supply-chain provenance (flagged via a juniper-labeled batch tag on the key) triggers a review. If confirmed as one operator, the ledger applies a glacier-slow penalty: future registrations from that operator's known vertex — the procurement fingerprint — require escalating review deposits that grow linearly with cluster size,
